summary: Full review of everything it knows now: 774 setups, 3083 concepts, 382 lessons. Setups: use 29 (#5, #46, #54, #56, #82, #85, #95, #139, #183, #289, #300, #347, #373, #374, #375, #411, #416, #446, #448, #450, #499, #509, #522, #547, #550, #574, #656, #749, #803), fix 2, watch 106, drop 637 - most new ones repeat a setup it already has (the same trades and edge written differently), use a price or typo as an indicator length, can't fire, or don't beat random. Concepts: keep 2901, drop 174, reword 8. Lessons: delete 19 (failed to read, or not trading material); the hundreds of 'BITCOIN PUMP / URGENT UPDATE' streams are kept, but their dated price talk is dropped as concepts. Chart tab (BTC, 15m to 1D) re-rated with Kraken's real 0.8% round-trip fee: 3857 arrows (average 2.1 stars; 15m-1h mostly 1 star because their targets are too small for the fees), 8 current calls, 8 missed trades. Setup numbers come from your last Learn - press Learn now after updating so they're recomputed with the fee setting.
